#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations
import sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SCRIPTS=ROOT/'scripts'
if str(SCRIPTS) not in sys.path: sys.path.insert(0,str(SCRIPTS))
import omega_fred_selftest as fred
import omega_runtime as runtime

def test_fred_self_probe_uses_omega_as_test_object_without_authority():
    result=fred.run_probe(owner='gabriel',machine_id='ai-core-node',host=False)
    assert result['ok'] is True
    assert result['self']=='OMEGA'
    assert result['self_as_test_object'] is True
    assert result['authority'] is False
    assert result['canonical_truth_credit'] is False
    assert result['effect_authority'] is False
    assert result['promotion_credit'] is False
    assert result['deployment_law'][:4]==['REALITY_REENTRY','ISOLATED_SANDBOX_BUILD_TEST','MATERIALIZE_EXACT_TESTED_DELTA','PRODUCT_RETEST']
    assert result['cognitive_probe']['ok'] is True

def test_fred_self_probe_keeps_counterfactual_credit_fail_closed():
    result=fred.cognitive_self_probe(owner='gabriel',machine_id='ai-core-node')
    assert result['ok'] is True
    names={item['name']:item for item in result['checks']}
    assert names['credit_fail_closed']['ok'] is True
    assert names['reentry_requires_regulation']['ok'] is True

def test_fred_self_probe_never_reads_local_bearer_token():
    source=(SCRIPTS/'omega_fred_selftest.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'OMEGA_LOCAL_EFFECT_TOKEN' not in source
    assert 'omega-mcp.env' not in source
    assert 'write_text' not in source

def test_runtime_exposes_fred_selftest_as_diagnostic_not_world_brain():
    data=runtime.manifest()
    assert data['organs']['fred_selftest']['present'] is True
    assert 'fred_selftest' not in data['world_brain_path']
